question: To which state does Indian shooter Abhinav Bindra belong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Abhinav Bindra is a renowned Indian shooter born on 28 September 1982.
 
• He hails from Dehradun, which is the capital city of Uttarakhand.
 
• Bindra is the first Indian to win an individual gold medal in the Olympics, achieving this feat at the 2008 Beijing Olympics in the 10m Air Rifle event.
 
• He has been awarded numerous honors, including the Arjuna Award in 2000 and the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna in 2001.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Olympic Gold Medal**

 
 
• Abhinav Bindra won the gold medal in the Men's 10m Air Rifle event at the 2008 Beijing Olympics.
 
• This victory marked India's first individual gold medal in Olympic history.
 
• Bindra's final score was 700.5, with 596 in the qualifying round and 104.5 in the finals.
 
 
 
• **Commonwealth and Asian Games**
 
 
• Bindra has also achieved success in the Commonwealth Games, winning multiple medals across different editions.
 
• He won gold medals in the 2002 and 2010 Commonwealth Games.
 
• At the Asian Games, he won the gold in the 2014 Incheon Games in the 10m Air Rifle event.
 
 
 
• **Other Honors and Contributions**
 
 
• Abhinav Bindra has been awarded the Padma Bhushan, India's third-highest civilian award, in 2009.
 
• He has also authored his autobiography titled "A Shot at History: My Obsessive Journey to Olympic Gold".
 
• Bindra is actively involved in promoting sports and shooting in India through his foundation and various initiatives.
